description: Haskell is a language built around functions. It encourages making new values instead of changing old ones. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install GHC. Save one example as lesson.hs and run runghc lesson.hs. Keep any definitions above main in the same file.
versionNote: Examples use GHC 9.2 or later and the standard Prelude.
whatYouWillLearn: Write a type guide with Haskell
